lines: “汀州府，东山神族治下深雾区雾府之一。”
临江府府邸内，在沈长青面前的火光中很快就出现了一行字，“此届神子基本信息如下：周奕，上品玄命，神变境前期修为。”
“洪佩雯，中品玄命，神变境前期修为。”
“叶闻夺，下品玄命，神变境前期。”
“戴琪，下品玄命，突破神变失败，目前化丹境后期修为。”
火光中一下子列举出了十位汀州府神子的基本信息，沈长青阅读完之后顿时道：“看来这周奕说的东西应该都没什么问题。”
当然，神子的三条路只要多问问其实并不难验证，对方想骗自己也骗不了。
至于这周奕为何会主动上来相告，或许只是单纯好心也说不定。
“不过倒是没想到这汀州府的整体实力居然这么弱，十位神子中竟只有一位上品玄命，外加四位中品玄命与五位下品玄命。”
看到这汀州府的情况，沈长青才突然发觉当初临江府的五位上品玄命与八位中品玄命的阵容是多么豪华。
另外，汀州府的人已经提前来到此处半个多月，但他们的十位神子中最后成功突破到神变境的，却只有六位。
“这周奕如此热心，就是可惜实力太弱了，希望他们能在神子大会中取得自己满意的成绩吧。”
沈长青先前凭借着圆满的《万化归玄炼体真经》感受了一下，发现周奕虽为上品玄命，但或许是刚突破不久，因此实力十分一般，无法让他感受到丝毫的威胁。
火光彻底散去，他随之不再多想，回到自己的房间后便开始修炼。
此地灵气逼人，四天后便是神子大会，时间虽已不多，但提升实力总是没错的。
另一边。
汀州府府邸内。
“临江府，东山神族治下深雾区雾府之一。”
周奕看着眼前的火光，神情期待，“此届临江府斩妖大会遭遇雾妖袭击，故最终只有三位神子抵达净土。”
“当中为首者名为沈长青，其乃中品奇命，神变境前期修为。”
“其二者为沈长青之妻李沐颜，下品玄命，目前处于闭关突破状态中。”
“其三者为沈长青之徒楚修，上品玄命，目前处于闭关突破状态中。”
火光缓缓散去之时，周奕眼前出现了一群人，正是汀州府的几位突破至神变境的神子。
一名男子道：“斩妖大会上遭遇雾妖袭击吗……最后只剩下三位神子活着抵达净土，想必其中定是发生了极其惨烈的事件，周师兄，可有详细打探？”
“求索符无法卜算出来。”
周奕摇头道：“或许是觉得影响不好，所以东山神族的大人已经提前出手屏蔽了天机。”
“看来事情应该比我们想象的严重许多。”
一名女子也开口了，她满头红发，正是汀州府十大神子中排名仅次于周奕的洪佩雯，“不过当真是没想到这临江府仅剩的三位神子竟会以沈长青这位中品奇命为首。”
“不足为奇，毕竟且不说另外的两位神子如今还没成功突破，就是以他们之间的关系，会照顾一下小小奇命的自尊也是合理的。”
周奕呵呵一笑，道：“不过，能以沈长青这样一位中品奇命为首，想必这李沐颜与楚修即便突破至神变境也没什么能耐。”

"Tingzhou Mansion, one of the fog mansions in the deep fog area under the rule of the Dongshan Divine Clan."
In the Linjiang Mansion, a line of words quickly appeared in the firelight in front of Shen Changqing, "The basic information of this divine son is as follows: Zhou Yi, top grade Xuanming, early stage cultivation of the divine transformation realm."
"Hong Peiwen, middle-grade Xuanming, early-stage cultivation of the Divine Transformation Realm."
"..."
"Ye Wenduo, low-grade Xuanming, early stage of divine transformation."
"Dai Qi, low-grade Xuan Ming, failed to break through the divine transformation, and is currently in the late stage of the alchemy realm."
"..."
The basic information of the ten divine sons of Tingzhou Prefecture was listed in the light of the fire. After reading it, Shen Changqing said immediately: "It seems that there is nothing wrong with what Zhou Yi said this time."
Of course, the three paths of the Son of God are actually not difficult to verify as long as you ask more questions, and the other party cannot deceive you even if they want to.
As for why Zhou Yi took the initiative to tell the truth this time, maybe it was just out of good intentions.
"But I didn't expect that the overall strength of Tingzhou Mansion would be so weak. Among the ten divine sons, there is only one high-grade Xuanming, plus four middle-grade Xuanming and five low-grade Xuanming."
Seeing the situation in Tingzhou Mansion, Shen Changqing suddenly realized how luxurious the Linjiang Mansion's lineup of five high-grade Xuanming and eight middle-grade Xuanming were.
In addition, the people from Tingzhou Prefecture had arrived here more than half a month in advance, but only six of their ten divine sons succeeded in breaking through to the realm of divine transformation.
"Zhou Yi is so enthusiastic this time, but it's a pity that they are too weak. I hope they can achieve satisfactory results in the Son of God Conference."
Shen Changqing had previously used the perfect "Wanhua Guixuan Body Refining Manual" to experience it, and found that although Zhou Yi was a top-grade Xuanming, he might have just broken through, so his strength was very average, and he could not feel the slightest threat.
After the fire completely dissipated, he stopped thinking about it and began to practice after returning to his room.
The spiritual energy of this place is overwhelming. In four days, there will be the God's Son Conference. Although there is not much time left, it is always right to improve your strength.
other side.
Inside the Tingzhou Mansion.
"Linjiang Mansion, one of the fog mansions in the deep fog area under the rule of the Dongshan God Clan."
Zhou Yi looked at the fire in front of him with an expectant expression, "This Linjiang Mansion Demon Slaying Conference was attacked by the fog demon, so in the end only three sons of gods arrived in the pure land."
"The leader among them is Shen Changqing. He is a middle-grade Qi Ming, who has cultivated in the early stages of the Divine Transformation Realm."
"The two are Shen Changqing's wife Li Muyan, a low-ranking Xuanming, who is currently in a state of seclusion and breakthrough."
"The three of them are Shen Changqing's disciple Chu Xiu. They are high-ranking Xuanming and are currently in a state of seclusion and breakthrough."
When the fire slowly dissipated, a group of people appeared in front of Zhou Yi. They were several divine sons from Tingzhou Mansion who had broken through to the realm of divine transformation.
A man asked: "Were we attacked by the mist demon during the demon-slaying conference... In the end, only three sons of gods were left alive to reach the Pure Land. It must have been an extremely tragic incident. Senior Brother Zhou, can you inquire in detail?"
"The talisman cannot be calculated."
Zhou Yi shook his head and said: "Perhaps he felt that the impact was not good, so the adults of the Dongshan Divine Clan had already taken action to block Tianji in advance."
"It seems like things are much more serious than we thought."
A woman also spoke. She had red hair and was none other than Hong Peiwen, who ranked second only to Zhou Yi among the top ten divine sons in Tingzhou Prefecture. "But I really didn't expect that the only three remaining divine sons in Linjiang Prefecture would be led by Shen Changqing, a middle-grade Qi Ming."
"Not surprising. After all, not to mention that the other two Sons of God have not yet succeeded in breaking through. Even with the relationship between them, it is reasonable to take care of Xiao Xiao Qiming's self-esteem."
Zhou Yi chuckled and said: "However, with a middle-grade Qi Ming like Shen Changqing as the leader, Li Muyan and Chu Xiu must not be able to do anything even if they break through to the Divine Transformation Realm."
